inventory.evidence: The current-day exact-URL inventory record in docs/audits/2026-10-26-version-release-watch-sources.json attempted all 200 URLs then registered. The two sources added concurrently afterward—the ES 8.8 AI Threat Graph Detection task guide and October 19 Splunk AI Assistant FedRAMP High announcement—were each retrieved and claim-checked by their owning same-day ES and CSP/FedRAMP watches and reconciled into this audit, giving 202 current registered sources. Retrieval is not blanket claim verification. The four unavailable exact bodies retain their prior scoped evidence and were not replaced by adjacent pages.

claimChecks.section: Current Splunk Cloud Platform and premium app versions; Supported forwarder versions
claimChecks.qualification: Current Cloud 10.6 pairs with ES 8.7 and ITSI 5.0. Forwarder rows apply to the tier directly connected to Cloud and do not establish historical availability, tenant rollout, entitlement or authorization.
10.6.0 marks ES 8.7 and lower incompatible with cohosted KV Store 1.0; the separate 10.6.1.1-and-higher footnote is not generalized to the displayed 10.6.1 row or an unlisted ES version.

claimChecks.section: Splunk Core Products; Universal Forwarder; current version tables
claimChecks.qualification: Explicit Enterprise deadlines remain separate from Cloud support and the guide's 180-day planning reminder. Universal Forwarder full and P3 windows remain distinct.

The section states Controlled Availability and then describes the enhancement list as a General Availability release. Both remain visible; Automation Broker HA enablement and embedded UF 10.4.4 do not establish tenant rollout, entitlement, region or authorization.

claimChecks.section: September 22 build 243 correction; Python 3.9 end of support
claimChecks.qualification: Build 243 repairs the documented build 232 defects; Python 3.13 compatibility is required. Conditional upgrade bridges and privileged/Phantom paths remain separate.
The repair applies when FIPS is enabled and remains distinct from App for SOAR, SOAR server releases and platform security floors.

The October APM filter behavior and October 21 call-graph, MetricSet, chart-baseline and IBM MQ records remain rolling-service milestones; Controlled Availability and customer-managed component versions stay separate.
Cloud Connected certificate setup, Agent Mode memory and model-runtime choices do not establish every provider, region, subagent rollout or customer authorization.

Each mapping retains an exact official URL, supporting sections, claim-specific verification date and anti-broadening qualification. Dates remain distributed across October 18-26; this audit does not advance unchanged borrowed dates.

Ten named capabilities retain product/evidence-version scope, separate stage, edition, dependency, provider/region, entitlement, enablement and authorization fields. Evidence-version filtering is not installed-stack validation.
